decisions.reason: This fire-resistant steel exterior door remains very close to our established metal-door, certification, and compliance capabilities, so our existing knowledge and R&D make continued improvement and commercialization likely.

The online ordering and digital services platform is somewhat less core than our physical products but strengthens our service-led strategy and can be refined through learning from customers and integration with our existing planning and maintenance processes.

The fire and smoke protection door fits directly with our technical, regulatory, and safety expertise, giving us strong absorptive capacity to interpret market feedback and enhance the product within our core business.
